Fetch an expression matrix

fetch_matrix.Rd

Returns the expression values of a set of features (all features of the assay by default) for a set of cells as a features x cells matrix, sparse (dgCMatrix) by default. On the Julia engine the block is read natively (BPCells directories, h5ad files); otherwise the layer is sliced in R.

Usage

fetch_matrix(
  object,
  features = NULL,
  ...,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = NULL,
  cells = NULL,
  sparse = TRUE
)

# S3 method for class 'AnnDataR6'
fetch_matrix(object, features = NULL, ..., matrix_location = features)

# S3 method for class 'Seurat'
fetch_matrix(
  object,
  features = NULL,
  ...,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = NULL,
  cells = NULL,
  sparse = TRUE
)

# S3 method for class 'SingleCellExperiment'
fetch_matrix(
  object,
  features = NULL,
  ...,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = NULL,
  cells = NULL,
  sparse = TRUE
)

# S3 method for class 'scuba_source'
fetch_matrix(
  object,
  features = NULL,
  ...,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = NULL,
  cells = NULL,
  sparse = TRUE
)

Arguments

object

a single-cell object (Seurat, SingleCellExperiment, scuba_source, AnnData).

features

feature names (bare, or keyed with the assay key); NULL for all features.

...

Passed to methods (matrix_location for AnnData objects).

assay

assay / modality (default: the default assay).

layer

layer to read (default: default_layer()).

cells

cells to include, in the returned order (default: all cells).

sparse

return a dgCMatrix (default) or a dense matrix.

matrix_location

(AnnData objects) the legacy slot to return, for example "X" or c("obsm", "X_umap"); defaults to features.

Value

A features x cells matrix with dimnames.

Details

For AnnData (reticulate) objects the legacy signature fetch_matrix(object, matrix_location) still returns the raw slot ("X", c("obsm", "X_umap"), ...).

Methods (by class)

  • fetch_matrix(AnnDataR6): AnnDataR6 objects
